snippet.title: The Sensei's Home
snippet.description:
Old Japanese ways to run a household: how to cut your bills, keep your food, and fix what breaks.

Japan has had little land, hot wet summers, cold houses and expensive fuel for a very long time. Out of that came several hundred small practical habits and about a hundred of them work just as well in Ohio or Florida as they do in Kyoto.

No invented numbers here. Savings are given as ranges, because your house is not my house.

塵も積もれば山となる — even dust, piled up, becomes a mountain.

snippet.title: Wild Camp Adventure
snippet.description:
Hello and welcome to Wild Camp Adventure!

I’m a wild mountain boy who finds peace in remote forests, rugged mountains, and wild landscapes.
This channel is all about solo adventures, camping, bushcraft, and reconnecting with the raw beauty of nature.

There’s no talking here—just the real sounds of wind, fire, rain, and the forest.
Every video is made to feel immersive, like you’re right there with me: building shelters, cooking over fire, hiking through untouched terrain, and facing real survival challenges.

Whether you’re a nature lover, a bushcraft enthusiast, or just someone looking to escape the noise of modern life—you’ll feel at home here.
I keep it simple, real, and focused on the experience.

Subscribe and become part of a growing community that loves nature, bushcraft skills, and wilderness survival.
Let’s embark on this journey together and live the spirit of adventure! 🌲🔥

From cooking in nature to building a shelter in the mountains, we experience everything to touch the real feeling of living in nature. If you are interested in survival skills, bushcraft, camping and relaxation in nature, this channel is for you! This is not just a channel, it is a lifestyle! In each video we try to convey a real experience of nature to you. From lighting a fire without modern equipment to preparing delicious meals in the heart of the forest and mountains. We learn how to survive in harsh conditions of nature with minimal resources, build shelter, find water and food sources and enjoy every moment of being in the heart of mountains, forests and plains. We have been living off grid and homesteading with no public utilities for the past decade where we preserve the old ways and get closer to our food. Our passion is to blend “old ways” with a modern twist so people like you can be more self-reliant, live an intentional life, and be a healthier you.


By joining our posse ya’ll get tips on:

living off grid
raising farm animals
homesteading
rainwater catchment
raised bed gardening
cooking from scratch on a wood cookstove
herbal remedies

snippet.title: COLE BRIGGS SECRETS
snippet.description:
https://colebriggssecrets.com/

For generations, Appalachian mountain families across Tennessee, Kentucky, and West Virginia have lived without grocery bills, without government dependence, and without relying on systems most people can't imagine surviving without.


These families haven't needed a grocery store since 1987 — here is the exact system, step by step, for any home you already own.

We just knew things.

This channel is a record of those methods — the ones quietly removed from mainstream knowledge when the government decided self-reliance was inconvenient, the ones that still work today, and the ones nobody is talking about.

New video every week.

Subscribe if you want to know what they decided you shouldn't stockpile anymore.

The communities I'm talking about are traditional mountain families of the Appalachian highlands — not all preppers are the same, and some of what gets sold as "survival content" today would get you laughed out of a hollow in 1987.

snippet.title: Steve Unsupervised
snippet.description:
Welcome to Steve Unsupervised  - exploring Cornwall and beyond, one place, person and story at a time.

From dramatic coastlines and historic towns, to forgotten railways, remarkable characters and stories hiding in plain sight, I go out and discover what makes a place worth knowing.
Expect local history, unusual journeys, walks, interviews and conversations with the people I meet along the way -sometimes serious, sometimes surprising and occasionally slightly unsupervised. 
Cornwall is home and the heart of the channel, but the story doesn't stop at the Tamar. I'll also be travelling further afield in search of fascinating places and stories across Britain.
If you enjoy British history, travel, railways, coastal scenery, local characters and discovering something you didn't know yesterday, you're very welcome here.

New videos every week.

snippet.title: Away Together w/ Nik and Allie
snippet.description:
Thanks for checking out Away Together! We want to help DIY travelers like you plan, afford, and enjoy better travel with your friends and loved ones. 

Sometimes travel (especially international travel) seems too big, too hard, and too unobtainable. 

We’re here to help show you this isn’t true – not even close! This channel helps you unlock those paths to traveling more often, make the planning process easy, and ensure you enjoy the experience all along the way! 

The content we post usually fits into one of the following categories:
💡Travel Tips – Videos about where to go, what to do, how to put an itinerary together, choose the right gear, and in general, travel like a pro.

💸Travel Hacks – Info about how to afford travel, the best credit cards for travelers, finding cheap flights, and in general, how to get more bang for your buck.

🎥 Travel Vlogs – This is where we recount our own adventures and show you we’re real people who used to only dream of epic travel –  and now we do it!

snippet.title: LifeWorthLiving
snippet.description:
ABOUT MYSELF :
👋 Hey, I'm Nomi. I spend countless hours every day, I find it very difficult to find the really specific and useful content for my audience to deliver about finance, economy and some motivation, so I work with some friends and started my own YouTube channel.

Speeches/Audio
- The speeches used in our videos are written and narrated by us, the LifeWorthLiving Team, which includes in-house scriptwriters and voice actors. Our videos also feature audio samples from various economist and motivational speakers in accordance with YouTube monetization policies. 

Visuals
- Visuals are licensed through Storyblocks and are edited by us. We add high quality effects, transitions to create original and unique video releases in accordance with YouTube channel monetization policies. 

Editing software
- Our videos are edited using the program, Adobe Premiere Pro and Filmora

Music
- Our background music is licensed through audioblocks.

"LifeWorthLiving (Better Finance Better Living)."
